title: Figure 4: Electron micrograph of shear bands in bent zirconium-based metallic glass
description: Grayscale scanning electron micrograph of a curved bent specimen edge covered in fine branching shear-band lines, with a 200 µm scale bar. The caption reads "Figure 4. Shear Bands. Produced by bending of a zirconium-based metallic glass." It sits above the report's 'Fracture Toughness' section.
